description: Pins the base images of the Dockerfiles and the images of deploy/docker-compose.yml by digest and groups their updates. NuGet and npm stay out of scope: they are updated by hand.

packageRules.description: The golden-capture environment reproduces the original PHP byte for byte; its images change only by hand.
One weekly pull request for every non-major image update: the first digest pin, digest refreshes, minor and patch versions.
The .NET SDK and ASP.NET Core runtime images move together.
Major image versions (database engines, Node, nginx) need a deliberate change and a migration check.
